resources.string: Constellations are officially recognized patterns of stars in the night sky that form recognizable shapes, figures, or outlines.
Numbers are mathematical objects used for counting, measuring, and labeling, with primary types including natural numbers (1, 2, 3…), whole numbers, and integers.
There are eight officially recognized planets in our solar system, orbiting the Sun in this order: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune.
